ownedWeaponsUnused.text: Tribute 14 crosses the boundary into The Center Podium and pulls a retaining pin from a camera gantry above Tribute 4; the falling frame is fatal.

Tribute 8 suspends a falling log over a supply trail in The Center Podium with a rope, waiting until Tribute 11 passes below. Released from above, the log strikes Tribute 11's head with fatal force. The log rolls clear and leaves the rope hanging slack.
Tribute 1 crosses the boundary into The Center Podium and kicks a corroded stair tread loose beneath Tribute 2; the fatal fall breaks their neck.
Tribute 3 tries to climb a steep cut bank in The Center Podium rather than face Tribute 1. Tribute 1 stamps on the reaching fingers; the fall onto the hard footing below kills Tribute 3.
Tribute 21 crosses the boundary into The Center Podium and releases a heavy service hatch onto Tribute 14 below; the impact kills them.
Tribute 1 stops in The Center Podium to work a trapped heel out of a fence gap. Tribute 21 notices the delay and attacks with a loose fence post; the blow kills Tribute 1 before the foot comes free.
At a broken bench in The Center Podium, Tribute 19 forces Tribute 2's thigh against a splintered metal brace. Tribute 2 tears free of the brace but cannot stop the fatal bleeding.
Tribute 16 tries to jab a jagged scrap past a stack of crates in The Center Podium. Tribute 15 drops a loose crate lid onto the hand, and the scrap disappears between the stacked bases.

Tribute 11 deliberately leaves footprints circling an empty recess in The Center Podium. Tribute 5 follows the loop and meets Tribute 11 coming the other way with a broken tile; a blow to the temple is fatal.
Tribute 16 crosses the boundary into The Center Podium and pushes a loose masonry block from a low wall onto Tribute 24; the head injury kills them.
